item.title: 游戏开发周刊 第 002 期
item.description: MCP 2.0 发布 Stateless 模式、DeepSeek V4 Flash 继续压低推理成本、GPT-5.6 四个月降价 13 倍——AI 开发基础设施这周变化剧烈，每一条都影响你的工具链选型。 🎮 Unity 官方与引擎 · Why go D2C now: The mobile game webshop business case · Unity brings dedicated engine support to Netflix Games · LGPL Bink 1 video decoder and encoder - open sourced 🤖 AI × 游戏开发 · Stateless MCP has recaptured my interest (and inspired mcp-explorer and datasette-mcp) · deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 · Building Context-Aware AI for Unity: Project Brain & Visual Reskin · Launch HN: Tokenless (YC S26) – Automatic model switching to save money · [AINews] GPT 5.6 price cut by 20%-80%: Cost of GPT 5.4 Intelligence dropped 13x in 4 months due to GPT 5.6 recursive self-optimization · Ontologies Are So Back: Why AI Agents Are Reviving the Semantic Web 🛠 工具与开源 · Doriax Game Engine Hands-On · August 2026 FREE GameDev Asset Round-Up · GodotHub – Awesome New Launcher for Godot · Add Cinematic Volumetric Fog To Blender Scenes In Just Minutes · Creating Intricate Filigree Metalwork Patterns for a Material with Substance 3D 📊 独游与市场 · How do PC player demographics change at 50 hours vs. 30 minutes? · Gamesight: Creators are best predictor for a game's success, not viewership · Is Friendslop saturated? · How Palworld went viral and made its way to version 1.0 · EA acquisition set to close on August 4 following approval from required regulatory bodies 📝 技术长文 · I broke everything in my vehicle suspension system to rebuild it better than ever, I'm super happy with the result · Codex from 0 to 10M Users: Building ChatGPT Work — Akshay Nathan, OpenAI

item.description: 本期头条是 Unity CLI——官方第一次把整个 Unity 生态搬上命令行，AI agent 驱动编辑器终于有了官方入口；同周还有 Unity 7 重回路线图、实时 GI 立项，AI 侧 Opus 5 与 FLUX 3 前后脚落地，市场侧 GameDiscoverCo 一口气给了三份能直接拿去定策略的数据。 🎮 Unity 官方与引擎 · Unity CLI + Unity Pipeline = Game Changers · Unity 7 is Back · Unity Getting Real-Time Global Illumination · Web Platform - What shipped in 6.5, and what's coming in 6.6 · Multiplayer Service Package v2.3.0 is now publicly available · Unity has been dethroned by Godot for the first time in the GMTK Game Jam 2026. 🤖 AI × 游戏开发 · [AINews] Claude Opus 5: Fable-level performance at Opus price (half Fable) · [AINews] Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 - Multimodal Flow Models that beat Seedance 2.0, Gemini Omni and Grok Imagine, and FLUX-mimic video-action robotics model · Bringing Nunchaku 4-bit Diffusion Inference to Diffusers · #002: Reaching the 'Next Level' with Mike Cook · Anatomy of a Frontier Lab Agent Intrusion: A Technical Timeline of the July 2026 Incident · An Inside Look at the Relay Market Powering Token Resellers and Fraud · Why China is embracing AI and "very few" studios refuse to adopt it · An opinionated guide to which AI to use to do stuff 🛠 工具与开源 · regiellis/godot-mcp-go：Control a running Godot 4.7 editor and game directly from the terminal. Includes a Go CLI, editor addon, 312 commands, and an MCP server with dynamically generated tool schemas. · Show HN: OneCLI – OSS credential gateway that keeps secrets out of AI agents 📊 独游与市场 · How Guildrun genre-mashed its way to ~300k demo players in 10 days · Will fewer people buy your Steam game due to player reviews? · What 'long tail' should you expect for your PC game in 2026? · "Across the industry, we don't think enough about how we match the scope to what we're making" – Mike Bithell on why the world needs an im-slim · My game was stolen by Chinese "developers" and they’re actually making money from it?! 📝 技术长文 · Interview: How EverQuest Legends Recreates Classic EverQuest's Iconic Visual Style · A one-line SQL query was silently wiping my players' cosmetics on every deploy
